headline: 25 notable citizen-written complaints this week in Austin

items.text: Why is it ok for this guy to break 4 violations every single day? He parks his black SUV at the corner of 2nd and Nueces St in a no-parking zone, blocking a fire hydrant, a stop sign, and a crosswalk at one of the busiest intersections downtown. He creates multiple safety hazards everyday. I’m so tired of him putting pedestrians and others at risk! There’s no need for him to park here.

The city just came and removed a bunch of trees from this park but left the stumps sticking up, which are a hazard for children and dogs running through the park. They need to be ground down with a stump grinder to prevent trips and falls. Additionally, when left like this they decay and grow poisonous mushrooms that are dangerous for curious kids and pets. Thank you!

Rooftop space above Medusa bar 706 w 6th street blasting bass way over permit limit for hours. And they have NO OUTDOOR MUSIC PERMIT YET. it’s under review. Like one customer or just employees at their bar. Please teach them of permitted bass limits. They’re new and already operating outside of permit because they have none yet. I live in condos directly across from them and bass is going through

Lawless Luna - after months of repeat violations, there hasn’t been any action taken to stop this place from breaking the law every single weekend! So either this app should be dismantled or Luna should be held accountable. PERIOD!

Trail maintenance HEAVILY needed. There is trees down blocking trail. Grass and weeds are up to bench height and unsafe to sit. It is one of the new trails that crosses the creek and connects the park to the soccer complex and it’s sad to see in this bad of shape.

NOACN001. Summary: No problem found.
Details: Thank
you for contacting Austin Transportation and Public Works Street & Bridge

request will be logged for informational purposes. If further assistance is
needed, please contact our Customer Service Group at 512-974-8777. Thank you
for your time. .
items.address: Rio Grande St & W 28th Half St, Austin

items.text: Is there a timeline for turning on the traffic lights on Parker between Samsung Blvd & Harris Branch Pkwy? I would really like them to be turned on as soon as possible, they’re installed so it should only be a matter of flipping a switch, right? With all of the apartments and new build houses being installed in the area, it’s getting really difficult and dangerous to get out, especially for people

Hearn St is a 2 way road and that has become impossible now that cars are parking on both sides of the road. Unsafe for people crossing the road as they can’t see incoming traffic and unsafe for drivers because 2 cars do not fit between the parked cars and traffic backs up to lake Austin blvd. Goodwill needs there adequate parking or 1 side of the road has be be a no parking fire line. 
And Emerge

Every day, a black SUV parks at the corner of 2nd and Nueces St. in a no-parking zone, blocking a fire hydrant, a stop sign, and a crosswalk. He does this every single day and it’s just not safe! Every time I report this, they close out the ticket saying that nothing was there, but this guy is here all the time so I’m not sure why no one is seeing this when they go to check on it. Can you let me k

This address here Near North Burnet–Gateway, Austin, TX 78759, has a straight drop off with no railing and every time I ride my bike down the path over the bridge I see homeless people and meth heads going under this bridge. Can you please add railing or something to keep people from not going down the ramp?

There is no warning sign on Wynona where a construction site has raised the road and there is a HUGE bump. My car went over it and my air bags deployed! It is extremely dangerous. I will be filing a claim.

This is dangerous for cyclists and pedestrians.   Cyclist can be hit by vehicles driving 45 miles an hour and cyclist having to move into vehicular traffic due to overgrown weeds. Please remove before a fatality occurs

My citation request for this vehicle was closed out and the reason listed was the vehicle is on private property. The private property is a City of Austin Parks and Recreation site. Can citations not be issued to vehicles parked in the grass on COA park property? I can tow the vehicle, I am the supervisor of the site, but would rather have a citation for the motorist, if that is possible.

Thank you for putting the stop sign back up. The street name signs were damaged and not reinstalled.  I don’t know if it is COA responsibility or the HOA responsibility.  The photo shows the stop sign still down. It is back up now But the street name signs show in the photo.

The pothole is collecting standing water, creating a breeding ground for mosquitoes and posing a potential public health hazard. It is also making it difficult for lower-clearance vehicles to safely enter and exit the driveway, resulting in damage to vehicle front ends. Please repair the pothole as soon as possible to eliminate the safety and health concerns and restore safe access.

Green arrow and regular green ball I believe are to be out don’t know the exact directions but the signal head had have leds in it if that helps and I know there is only two like this at the intersection I believe and also last time I walked through intersection the buttons were not working properly

The light timing rotation is terrible, it rotates far too often to the side streets with little to no traffic and is out of sync with the nearby lights so that often when it turns green the next light a block away is just about to turn red. It makes it so that all the lights are effectively stop signs because they are never really green together or long enough. This is on decker lane.

follow up to request sent yesterday; Queso was 25+ feet away from me and my 2 dogs (1 senior, 1 five yo), Queso slipped out of collar, I stood still and unprovoked, Queso ran towards me, started attacking my 20 lb five yo, dog sitter watched without helping as I was trying to separate animals, I reached out to owners Sarah and Timothy Ruttan, MD at Dell Med, they have not responded to requests for

A Honda is illegally parked in a designated tour bus loading zone.  It is blocking tour buses from being able to park and load/unload customers.  This causes a backup of traffic. This vehicle needs to be towed. This car needs to be towed.

overgrown vines, tree branches,  weeds and grass are obstructing the sidewalk on the northeast corner of Dunn Street and Thomas Kincheon Street.You can't even tell there is a sidewalk there. Can this be cleaned up and cleared out so the crosswalk can be used as intended?

Shoal Creek trail needs to be maintained and have the over grown vegetation trimmed for safety and ada needs. I saw 2 bikes almost collide because the vegetation is taken over the entirety of the trail and people go around it.

Vegetation and trees and brush obstructing sidewalk for blind pedestrian and her service dog on West Dittmar Road behind the residences between 1100-1148 Brecon Lane.  Discovered during field investigation sent to Watershed Protection for CSR26-00241178.

aggressive neighbors’ dog (name is Queso, approx 60 lbs) lives at 4803 Evans Ave (event took place outside of location); on 07/30/2026 at 7:50 PM; dog slipped out of collar, saw me and my 2 dogs (one senior, one 5 yo), ran over to me and started to attack my 20 lb five year old dog; dog sitter let me know that owners did not disclose his aggressive behavior; let her know that they run through diff

Continued usage of Alexander Ave bike lane near MLK Jr light by delivery truck drivers (this time, Pepsi driver and U-Haul) forcing cyclists into main lanes near intersection. Request review of design and additional physical measures to prevent parking in bike lane.

On the Enfield hill, there are overgrown bushes obstructing the sidewalk. Anytime I am running, I have to step in the street to go around it, which is quite dangerous considering the inability to see cars over the hill.
Street light bulb out - missing lamp ID numbers but located at the intersection of E 6th St and Medina St. at the southeast corner adjacent to REI Studio LLC at 1101 E 6th St Ste A1, Austin, TX 78702

Extremely loud music blasting.  I am 20 floors up in a high rise and it is 10:30pm on Sunday night and I hear nonstop bass music.   The venue across the street is clearing violating the city noise ordinance and any permit for decibel allowance.

Dog is on a short tether (less than 3 feet) to a front yard tree without food or water and with no supervision. Owner does this frequently; this is my first time reporting. I have seen him come outside and hit the dog when it barks at passers by.

NOACN001. Summary: See details. Duplicate - 26-215490.
Details: Thank you for your request. Street and Bridge Operations reviewed and confirmed this is a duplicate request and is being addressed under work order 26-215490. .

Heavy gravel debris spill in NB Pleasant Valley bike lane at PV/12th intersection. This poses a fall hazard for cyclists if the back tire loses traction as well as a risk of puncturing tires. I have gotten a puncture at this intersection already so now I have to take the vehicle lane to avoud the gravel.

The streetlight at the bus stop (Stop ID 5881) flickers on and off on a regular cycle. It will stay on for ~1 minute, the cut out for ~90 seconds before turning on again. When it turns on, it glows with a white light but over the next minute fades into an orange color before cutting out abruptly, almost as if something’s overheating.

Our employee Charlotte Frey was bitten by a cat yesterday 7/28/26 at 3:26 pm who is owned by another employee Candace Thompson. She was bitten while holding the cat. Cat is not up to date with rabies vaccination. This employee to go out on Workers Comp compensation and did receive treatment.
items.address: 7501 N Capital of Texas Hwy NB, Austin

items.text: Deceased baby fawn pickup. I moved it off the sidewalk to the grass away from road, because mama deer kept coming close to the road to be with it. I saw it as I drove by. People scream down Westgate way over the speed limit. if you look for that cement thing, you’ll find it right there on the right. Just north of 5611 Westgate Blvd, on the East side of the street: pin:  https://maps.app.goo.gl/4Lb

1406 Arcadia slated for demolition, but the yard hasn’t been maintained. The grass is 12” high and they’ve dug a hole to access water (maybe) but that’s allowed dirt to cross the sidewalk. They’re not keeping up with the fallen tree limbs (I moved one from the street, so did the fire dept).

Vehicles parked in the bike lane on 38 1/2 every day. I’m not trying to snitch on anyone. This is a daily occurrence however, forcing cyclists to veer into traffic at 38 1/2 and Cherrywood. There is plenty of parking on adjoining streets.

Between E Howard Lane and Dessau, the signal was stuck on red. It was the light that was on E Howard lane (past Old Gregg) going West (towards 7-11)  A good portion of the vehicles took a u turn so they didn’t have to be stuck there.
Pothole/water valve needs repair. Adam from Austin Water came out 8/2 and couldn’t find it. Resubmitting with additional photos. It’s directly in the road across from Tan My restaurant at 1601 Ohlen
please help...about to have 4 buses show up and I have cars blocking the lane
I don’t know what Yasmin did but we can’t have this in the park bench! Needs to be removed. Thank you!
Crossstreets of Sendero Hills Parkway and FM 969 have extremely high weeds and can’t exit Sendero Hills Parkway safely NOR can westbound traffic be seen for 3 blocks away to exit safely
